name.ja: 計測: 本体のクラッシュ記録

description.en: The game's own make_crash_log dies with AttributeError: module 'datetime' has no attribute 'now', so crash_log.txt is not written and the crash is not sent. Records which calls take that branch, and whether swapping the name would have produced a log. Read-only: the original error is re-raised, so the game behaves exactly as it does now
description.ja: 本体の make_crash_log が AttributeError: module 'datetime' has no attribute 'now' で落ち、crash_log.txt が書かれず送信も走らない。どの呼び出しがその枝を通るのかと、名前を差し替えれば記録が出来たのかを録る。読むだけで、元の例外はそのまま投げ直すのでゲームの挙動は今と変わらない
